evals.expected_output: Runs pre-release checks, bumps the workspace version, updates changelog, creates an annotated tag
assertions: Runs fmt, clippy, tests, audit before release
Uses ./scripts/bump-version.sh rather than cargo update
Creates an annotated git tag

evals.prompt: Publish this crate to crates.io for the first time
evals.expected_output: Confirms the package is allowlisted and publishable, explains the one-time bootstrap prerequisite, and uses the repository CLI
assertions: Checks crates.io name availability first
Runs ./scripts/trustpub.sh bootstrap --package <name> and requires explicit confirmation
Does not claim a stable cargo trustpub subcommand exists

evals.prompt: What's the release process for this project?
evals.expected_output: Explains the release workflow, version scheme, and OIDC crates.io publish job
assertions: Describes pre-release checks
Explains semantic versioning
References cargo-dist, the release workflow, and config/trusted-publishing.json

evals.prompt: Publish every crate in the workspace to crates.io on the next tag
evals.expected_output: Refuses implicit workspace publishing and selects only the explicit allowlist
assertions: States publication is opt-in and package-scoped
Excludes crates/sample-app because it sets publish = false
Edits the allowlist rather than adding cargo publish --workspace

evals.prompt: Show me which crates would be published and to which workflow identity
evals.expected_output: Uses the read-only plan before any mutation
assertions: Runs ./scripts/trustpub.sh plan
Prints the owner, repository, workflow filename, and environment tuple
Performs no API mutation

evals.prompt: Enable trusted-publishing-only for my crate right after registering the publisher
evals.expected_output: Explains that enforcement is separate and must wait for a successful OIDC publish
assertions: Does not enable enforcement from configure or bootstrap
Requires --confirm-oidc-publish and explicit confirmation
Documents the --disabled rollback command

evals.prompt: The crates.io publish job failed with a 403; how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Checks token scope, crate ownership, and the registered identity tuple
assertions: Identifies a missing trusted-publishing token scope or missing ownership
Points to ./scripts/trustpub.sh verify --all-configured
Never asks to paste or print the token
